# Alibaba.com
> Alibaba.com is a global B2B marketplace for sourcing products, finding manufacturers and suppliers, and managing international trade.

Alibaba.com connects buyers, importers, wholesalers, and sourcing teams with manufacturers, exporters, and suppliers worldwide. The platform includes product discovery, factory sourcing, RFQ workflows, trade services, industry channels, and regional marketplace entry points.

## Marketplace Entry Points
- [Alibaba.com Homepage](https://www.alibaba.com/): Main B2B marketplace for discovering products, suppliers, and trade opportunities worldwide.
- [Manufacturers](https://www.alibaba.com/factory/index.html): Factory-focused marketplace for finding manufacturers, OEM partners, and production suppliers.
- [Worldwide](https://www.alibaba.com/global/index.html): Regionalized global marketplace entry point for international buyers across major markets.
- [AI Mode](https://aimode.alibaba.com/): AI-assisted sourcing experience for product discovery and supplier matching.
- [Request for Quotation](https://rfq.alibaba.com/rfq/profession.htm?tracelog=PCkeylanding): Submit sourcing requirements and receive supplier quotations for custom or bulk orders.
- [Top Ranking](https://sale.alibaba.com/p/dviiav4th/index.html?trafficsource=hometool): Curated ranking page highlighting popular products, suppliers, and marketplace trends.
- [Fast Customization](https://sale.alibaba.com/p/fast_customization?spm=215b402f.467434f.0.0.26a01774Br2Otw&wx_navbar_transparent=true&path=/p/fast_customization): Custom manufacturing entry point for rapid product personalization and supplier sourcing.

## Buyer Tools
- [Request for Quotation](https://rfq.alibaba.com/rfq/profession.htm?tracelog=PCkeylanding): Structured RFQ workflow for collecting quotes from multiple suppliers efficiently.
- [AI Mode](https://aimode.alibaba.com/): Conversational sourcing tool for narrowing products and identifying relevant suppliers.
- [Top Ranking](https://sale.alibaba.com/p/dviiav4th/index.html?trafficsource=hometool): Browse top-performing categories and products to guide sourcing decisions.
- [Fast Customization](https://sale.alibaba.com/p/fast_customization?spm=215b402f.467434f.0.0.26a01774Br2Otw&wx_navbar_transparent=true&path=/p/fast_customization): Start custom product sourcing with faster specification and supplier matching.
- [Worldwide](https://www.alibaba.com/global/index.html): Access localized marketplace experiences tailored to different buyer regions.

## Supplier Discovery
- [Manufacturers](https://www.alibaba.com/factory/index.html): Explore factory listings and production-oriented suppliers across industries.
- [Alibaba.com Homepage](https://www.alibaba.com/): Search broad supplier catalogs, products, and trade leads from one marketplace.
- [Worldwide](https://www.alibaba.com/global/index.html): Find suppliers serving specific countries and regional import markets.
- [Top Ranking](https://sale.alibaba.com/p/dviiav4th/index.html?trafficsource=hometool): Review highly ranked suppliers and trending sourcing categories.
- [AI Mode](https://aimode.alibaba.com/): Use AI guidance to refine supplier discovery and product selection.

## Custom Manufacturing
- [Fast Customization](https://sale.alibaba.com/p/fast_customization?spm=215b402f.467434f.0.0.26a01774Br2Otw&wx_navbar_transparent=true&path=/p/fast_customization): Launch custom product projects with streamlined sourcing and specification workflows.
- [Request for Quotation](https://rfq.alibaba.com/rfq/profession.htm?tracelog=PCkeylanding): Collect bids for custom manufacturing, private label, and bulk production needs.
- [Manufacturers](https://www.alibaba.com/factory/index.html): Identify factories suitable for OEM, ODM, and direct production partnerships.
- [AI Mode](https://aimode.alibaba.com/): Generate sourcing ideas and narrow customization options with AI assistance.

## Regional and Global Trade
- [Worldwide](https://www.alibaba.com/global/index.html): Regional gateway for buyers sourcing internationally through localized marketplace experiences.
- [Alibaba.com Homepage](https://www.alibaba.com/): Central platform for cross-border trade between buyers and suppliers.
- [Manufacturers](https://www.alibaba.com/factory/index.html): Source directly from factories for international wholesale and import programs.
- [Request for Quotation](https://rfq.alibaba.com/rfq/profession.htm?tracelog=PCkeylanding): Run cross-border sourcing projects by inviting supplier quotations at scale.

## Sourcing Intelligence
- [AI Mode](https://aimode.alibaba.com/): AI-powered sourcing assistant for product research and supplier recommendations.
- [Top Ranking](https://sale.alibaba.com/p/dviiav4th/index.html?trafficsource=hometool): Marketplace ranking signals for popular products and supplier visibility.
- [Alibaba.com Homepage](https://www.alibaba.com/): Broad product and supplier search for market scanning and category research.
- [Worldwide](https://www.alibaba.com/global/index.html): Compare sourcing opportunities across regions and buyer markets.

## Core Trade Workflows
- [Alibaba.com Homepage](https://www.alibaba.com/): Start product search, supplier outreach, and marketplace sourcing workflows.
- [Request for Quotation](https://rfq.alibaba.com/rfq/profession.htm?tracelog=PCkeylanding): Formalize purchasing requirements and gather competitive supplier responses.
- [Manufacturers](https://www.alibaba.com/factory/index.html): Move from product discovery to direct factory engagement.
- [Fast Customization](https://sale.alibaba.com/p/fast_customization?spm=215b402f.467434f.0.0.26a01774Br2Otw&wx_navbar_transparent=true&path=/p/fast_customization): Transition from idea to custom production sourcing quickly.
- [AI Mode](https://aimode.alibaba.com/): Accelerate early-stage sourcing research with guided AI interactions.
